subject: Re: Request for concession — session persistence delay impacting go-live
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-analytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Session persistence delay — request for concession

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from our engineering team: we hit a blocker integrating Redwood’s session persistence feature (stateful session restore) that you’d mentioned in the roadmap. The gap means our production P0 hit scheduled for next month will slip by at least 6 weeks unless we accept a suboptimal workaround.

This delay is material to our go-live and revenue recognition. Given the roadmap timing you shared and the integration work already done, can Redwood provide a limited commercial concession — either a one-time credit or an extension/discount on the first quarter of usage — to offset our implementation cost and make up for the schedule slippage?

I’ve attached the integration logs the team collected. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of ML, Acme Analytics
attachments: acme_integration_log.txt (text)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-22 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Session persistence delay — request for concession

Team — forwarding. Acme (ACME-2027-SMB) just surfaced a material delay driven by our session persistence not being GA in time for their integration. They want a one-time credit or discount on Q1 usage.

Quick asks:
- Lauren: can you confirm the exact feature scope promised and why the timing shifted?
- Karthik: what's the allowable commercial concession (range) for this ARR/commit?
- Marissa: frontline relationship context — how sensitive is this ask to renewal/expansion motion?
- Markus: looping you for exec sign-off if structural exception is needed.

Goal: respond within 24 hours with a concrete concession proposal we can present to Daniel.

— Vivek
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-22 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Session persistence delay — request for concession

Vivek / all,

Context: the GA rollout for stateful session restore was delayed by two items — (1) KV cache eviction change needed for larger batch sizes, (2) additional infra tests for dedicated GPU pools that found instability at long sequences. We pushed the fix but the validated GA date moved from 2027-05-15 to 2027-06-20.

Mitigation options we can offer without accelerating GA (and without breaking other customers):
- Provide a short-term SDK shim (client-side small change) to reduce impact; engineering effort = ~2 engineer-weeks.
- Offer a limited pre-GA variant (beta) with explicit guardrails for Acme — would require a support commitment and runbook.

Commercial ask: product is comfortable with a modest, one-time goodwill credit aligned to the integration cost. For this size account and their committed usage, I would recommend a credit not exceeding a single month of committed spend or a one-time $25k credit, whichever is lower. This keeps precedent conservative.

If we go the beta route, we should also require a limited PII-handling addendum and a support SLO.

— Lauren
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-22 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Session persistence delay — request for concession

Vivek, Lauren —

Finance view: concession budget for this deal (ACME-2027-SMB, expected ARR ~$420k) is limited. Standard playbook: one-time credit up to 5% of contracted first-year committed value without exec approval. Anything above that needs marks & approvals. 5% cap here ~= $21k.

If product recommends $25k, we need Markus to sign off on the delta (~$4k) or we reframe as a 1-month credit capped at usage which may come in below $21k.

Also prefer the credit be recorded as a contra-revenue line for clean accounting and attached to a credit memo. I can draft the memo if we decide.

— Karthik
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-22 16:54:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Session persistence delay — request for concession

Thanks for the context. Approve a one-time goodwill credit up to $25,000 for Acme on the condition that:

1) We tie the credit to a short statement of facts (date, feature gap, remediation timeline) and limit it as a single, non-recurring concession.
2) Legal drafts a quick amendment (or credit memo) that requires acceptance as part of the next billing cycle.
3) Product commits to the June 20 GA date (lauren — confirm in writing) and offers the SDK shim as an optional add-on.

Karthik — please prepare the contra-revenue credit memo and flag accounting treatment. Marissa — please step in on the renewal motion language so we don’t set a broad precedent.

Markus
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme-analytics.com>, contracts@acme-analytics.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-23 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for concession — session persistence delay impacting go-live

Daniel — thanks for the note and for sharing the logs. We reviewed this internally and want to be pragmatic.

Proposal: Redwood will issue a one-time, non-recurring goodwill credit of $25,000 (credit memo to be applied on your next invoice). Scope and conditions:
- The credit is being provided as compensation for the integration delay related to session persistence not yet GA.
- Redwood will make available (if you choose) a beta SDK shim and a limited-support pre-GA variant; both require a signed addendum and a support runbook.
- Product expects GA for session persistence on 2027-06-20; if that date changes materially we will notify you and revisit the remediation path.

Next steps: Karthik will send a credit memo and accounting note; contracts@redwood will send a brief amendment/acceptance form (DocuSign) to finalize. If you want the beta variant, let us know and Lauren will coordinate the technical runbook.

Link to DocuSign (will be sent): https://docusign.com/envelope/ENVELOPE-12345
Draft credit note (attached): credit_note_draft_acme.pdf

Would you like a quick call to finalize?

Best,
Vivek
